# TestScript for 30-bootstrapper — the environment tier outranks the
# configuration supplied by pipeline files.

copy-fixture testdata/fixtures/pipeline.yaml pipeline.yaml
copy-fixture testdata/fixtures/pipeline.local.yaml pipeline.local.yaml

env FLOWCTL_LOG_LEVEL=error
env FLOWCTL_PIPELINE=deploy

# 1. Environment values outrank the file's config keys, including the selected
#    pipeline's overlay.
exec flowctl
stdout '--pipeline\s+string\s+deploy\s+● env FLOWCTL_PIPELINE'
stdout '--log-level\s+string\s+error\s+● env FLOWCTL_LOG_LEVEL'
stdout 'pipeline deploy: needs=\[build\] steps=\[\./deploy\.sh\]'

# 2. CLI flags still outrank the environment.
exec flowctl --log-level warn
stdout '--log-level\s+string\s+warn\s+● cli --log-level'

# 3. FLOWCTL_FILE selects the pipeline file when no -f is supplied.
env FLOWCTL_FILE=pipeline.local.yaml
exec flowctl --pipeline deploy
stdout '--file\s+\[\]string\s+\[pipeline\.local\.yaml\]\s+● env FLOWCTL_FILE'
stdout 'pipeline deploy: needs=\[lint\] steps=\[\./notify\.sh\]'

# 4. A CLI -f value outranks FLOWCTL_FILE.
exec flowctl -f pipeline.yaml --pipeline deploy
stdout '--file\s+\[\]string\s+\[pipeline\.yaml\]\s+● cli --file'
stdout 'pipeline deploy: needs=\[build\] steps=\[\./deploy\.sh\]'
